title: About Sleep's Role in Memory
relation: Explains sleep as an active consolidation window rather than passive rest.
relationZh: 这篇把睡眠读成主动巩固窗口，适合转译成 agent 的离线整理、重放、压缩和冲突检测。
description: A review of sleep-dependent memory consolidation, including slow oscillations, spindles, sharp-wave ripples, replay, and memory reorganization.
descriptionZh: 文章综述睡眠如何参与记忆稳定、重组和系统巩固，重点是慢振荡、纺锤波、海马 sharp-wave ripples 与海马-皮层对话。
readingFocus: 先抓住睡眠不是被动休息，而是主动巩固窗口。
重点看 slow oscillation、spindle、sharp-wave ripple 的耦合。
把 replay 理解为记忆重激活和系统整合机制。
转到 agent 时只借鉴 offline consolidation，不要把 batch job 说成睡眠。
